rows.ja: ロイヤルティの受取先

relations.text: モーリタニアのタシアスト鉱山の金生産に2%のロイヤルティを持つ
relations.text_en: Holds a 2% life-of-mine royalty on Tasiast gold in Mauritania

source.label: Kinross 年次情報書(40-F添付、2025年度)
source.label_en: Kinross annual information form (40-F exhibit, FY2025)
source.quote: Tasiast is also subject to a 2% royalty payable to a subsidiary of Franco-Nevada Corporation on life of mine gold production.

companies.name: ロイヤル・ゴールド(旧サンドストーム)

relations.text: チリのロボ・マルテ計画にロイヤルティを持つ
relations.text_en: Holds a royalty on the Lobo-Marte project in Chile

source.label: Sandstorm Gold 年次情報書(40-F添付、2024年度)
source.label_en: Sandstorm Gold annual information form (40-F exhibit, FY2024)
source.quote: 1.75% NSR royalty on 60% of production (i.e. 1.05%) subject to a $40.0 million cap, on the development-stage Lobo-Marte project (" Lobo-Marte ") located in the Maricunga gold district (Atacama region) of Chile owned by Kinross Gold Corporation (" Kinross ").

relations.text: アラスカのマンチョ鉱山を持つPeak Gold(キンロス70%)の合弁相手
relations.text_en: Joint venture partner in Peak Gold (Kinross 70%), owner of Manh Choh in Alaska

source.label: Kinross 年次情報書(40-F添付、2025年度)
source.label_en: Kinross annual information form (40-F exhibit, FY2025)
source.quote: Our joint venture partner Contango ORE, Inc. has the power to appoint and replace the third member of the Management Committee.

companies.name: グレート・ベア・リソーシズ

relations.text: カナダのGreat Bear計画を買収(買収資金の10億ドル借入を2025年に完済)
relations.text_en: Bought the Great Bear project in Canada; repaid the $1 billion acquisition loan in 2025

source.label: Kinross 年次情報書(40-F添付、2025年度)
source.label_en: Kinross annual information form (40-F exhibit, FY2025)
source.quote: the Company repaid the remaining $200 million, completing repayment of the $1 billion term loan it took out to finance its acquisition of the Great Bear project.

companies.name: レッドバック・マイニング

relations.text: Red Backの買収でモーリタニアのタシアスト鉱山を取得
relations.text_en: Got the Tasiast mine in Mauritania by acquiring Red Back Mining

source.label: Kinross 年次情報書(40-F添付、2025年度)
source.label_en: Kinross annual information form (40-F exhibit, FY2025)
source.quote: Kinross acquired TMLSA, including the Tasiast operation and exploitation and exploration permits and lands, through its acquisition of Red Back Mining Inc.

relations.text: ガーナのチラノ鉱山の90%を2.25億ドルで売却(残金は2025年に株式等で精算)
relations.text_en: Sold 90% of the Chirano mine in Ghana for $225 million; the balance was settled in 2025

source.label: Kinross 年次情報書(40-F添付、2025年度)
source.label_en: Kinross annual information form (40-F exhibit, FY2025)
source.quote: On August 10, 2022, the Company announced that it had completed the sale of its 90% interest in the Chirano mine in Ghana to Asante Gold Corporation (" Asante ") for total consideration of $225.0 million in cash and shares.

companies.name: ゴールド・ロイヤルティ

relations.text: ネバダ州のバルド・マウンテン鉱山にロイヤルティを持つ
relations.text_en: Holds royalties on Kinross's Bald Mountain in Nevada

source.label: Gold Royalty 20-F(2025年度)
source.quote: Bald Mountain JV Kinross Gold Corporation (" Kinross ") 1.25% NSR Au Nevada, USA Bald Mountain(2) Kinross 2.0% NSR Au Nevada, USA

companies.name: インテグラ・リソーシズ

relations.text: アイダホ州のDeLamar計画を2017年にキンロスから買い取った
relations.text_en: Bought the DeLamar project in Idaho from Kinross in 2017

source.label: Integra Resources 年次情報書(40-F、2025年度)
source.label_en: Integra Resources annual information form (40-F, FY2025)
source.quote: All mineral titles and permits are held by the DeLamar Mining Company (" DMC "), an indirect, 100% wholly owned subsidiary of Integra that was acquired from Kinross through a stock purchase agreement in 2017.

companies.name: カレドニア・マイニング

relations.text: ジンバブエのブランケット鉱山を2006年にキンロスから買い取った
relations.text_en: Bought the Blanket mine in Zimbabwe from Kinross in 2006

source.label: Caledonia Mining 20-F(2025年度)
source.quote: The Blanket Mine is currently 64% indirectly owned and operated by Caledonia, which initially completed the purchase of the mine from Kinross on 1 April 2006.
